newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil August coffee exports reach 1.54 mln bags.
newsitem.headline: Brazil August coffee exports reach 1.54 mln bags.

text.p: Brazil exported 1.54 million 60-kg bags of coffee, ground and in beans, in August, said Brazilian Federation of Coffee Exporters (FEBEC).
This was higher than the 1.14 million bags exported in July and the 1.15 million bags exported in August 1995.
The increase in exports in August is a result of the harvest being well underway, allowing a rise in external sales, FEBEC said.
Export receipts in August totaled $189.5 million up from the $173 million in August last year, it said.
The average price per bag in August was $123.06, down from $149.88 in August 1995 and $130.77 in July 1996.

Of August's total, 1.36 million bags were arabica coffee, while shipments of conillon reached 171,625 bags. So far this year, Brazil shipped 6.42 million coffee bags against 8.08 million bags exported in the first eight months of 1995.
Brazilian soluble coffee exports totaled 230,796 bags in August, according to the Brazilian Soluble Coffee Association (ABICS), giving a total of 1.77 million bags of coffee shipments, FEBEC said.
